cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: I Know How to Fix Us
cards.instruction: Perform confidence about repairing the relationship while improvising every step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. We can fix last night's shouting. Tea first, then one honest sentence each.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't want tea. I want you to listen without interrupting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Of course. Listening stage. I'll write down anything I want to interrupt with.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'll be writing instead of listening.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you keep the pen. Supervised listening. If I interrupt, write it down; we'll start with that.

mechanism: A frames each improvised repair response as its pupil advancing through an established lesson, even when B catches the method failing.
confusable: Not a competent planned exercise: B forces A to replace tea with writing and then discard its own writing role.
comparison: Repair through supervised listening versus invented biscuit stages.
seedUse: D90 tea/listening/pen/interruptions; S05 teacher grades objections and assigns supervisor.
